test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In June 2022, the Supreme Court directed that every protected forest, national park and wildlife sanctuary across the country should have a mandatory eco-sensitive zone (ESZ) of a minimum ______ starting from their demarcated boundaries.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 km.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court **mandated **an **eco-sensitive zone** of at least **one kilometre **starting from each **national park **and **wildlife sanctuary **in the country in an order that was published on **June 3, 2022**.
 
• The decision was taken in **response **to a **petition **to **protect forested regions **in **Tamil Nadu's Nilgiris district.**
 
• This decision **nullifies **the **ESZ border limit **around protected areas, as the Supreme Court previously declared.
 
• **All states** and **Union Territories **where the minimum ESZ extent is not stated would also be subject to it.
 
• Due to ideological differences between the **federal **and **state administrations** as well as between the states and their respective states, India does not have a statute that mandates the maintenance of the **eco-sensitive zone** surrounding its protected area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Eco-Sensitive Zones (ESZs) **and **Ecologically Fragile Areas (EFAs)** are related words (EFAs).
 
• The **MoEFCC** declares regions close to national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, and protected areas as eco-sensitive zones.
 
• ESZs act as a kind of **"shock absorber" **for protected areas by regulating and monitoring activity inside and outside of them.
 
• The** National Board for Wildlife (NBWL)** asserts that any limitations should only be required when absolutely necessary and that the creation of eco-sensitive zones must be site-specific.
